messages:
ryan: Quick thread to lock down post-launch bugs vs enhancements flow. Need a simple, repeatable SLA + owner map we can hand to CS and eng.

jess: Echo — also we have two paying customers (AcmeCo, Finvera) who asked for guaranteed response windows. Need to capture that so CS can set expectations.

maria: Draft proposal: small set of severities tied to actions. Trying to keep it compact so folks actually use it.
```
Severity: Actions / Timing / Owner
P0: security/data exfiltration, data loss -> Escalate now, engineering hotfix within 24h. Owner: maria.
P1: crash or broken core flow (no workaround) -> Triage within 4h, fix in next 72h hotfix or rollback. Owner: alex.
P2: significant user impact with workaround -> Schedule in next sprint or hotfix window if >=1% traffic affected. Owner: tara.
P3: UI polish, performance tweak, enhancement -> Backlog + grouped release cadence (every 4 weeks). Owner: product grooming (jess/tara).
DoR: repro, customer impact, telemetry link, rough dev estimate
DoD: tests, rollback plan, release notes
```

alex: From eng: constraints: if a P1 requires >5 dev-days, treat as P2 enhancement unless customer SLA demands otherwise. Also require a quick estimate before hotfix scheduling.

tara: Release policy for grouped P3s: feature flags mandatory, canary at 10% traffic for 24h, automated smoke tests pass -> full rollout. Rollback via feature-flag kill + db-migration-reverse steps documented. I'll add a checklist.

sam: Telemetry thresholds I'll wire up: error-rate >0.5% sustained for 5m => P1 alert; spike multiplier x3 baseline (10m) => P2 alert. Will create Grafana panel and PagerDuty rule.

maria: I'll create the tracker and pre-populate with current post-launch reports and mark customer-priority items (AcmeCo, Finvera). Link will be in the tracker field.

cs-bot: Notifying contacts per template: AcmeCo (eng-ops@acme.co) and Finvera (support@finvera.io). Message template: "We
re investigating; expected initial response window: 4h"

deploy-bot: Post-deploy checklist: https://redwood.internal/releases/postlaunch-checklist (auto-post)

jess: A couple of tiny process asks: 1) CS must add "customer SLA" tag if contract demands faster response; 2) we should surface revenue impact estimate on P1/P0 items.

ryan: Actions agreed: maria -> tracker + customer tags by EOD; alex -> hotfix capacity estimate and rapid-estimate template; tara -> grouped-release checklist + rollback doc; sam -> dashboards & PD rules. I'll book a 20m sync Fri 10am to approve final wording.

maria: Confirmed. I'll also attach recent customer repros and include contact owner for each account.

alex: Confirmed. I'll add a quick triage template we can paste into issues with fields: steps-to-repro, impact, signal-links, rough-estimate.

tara: Confirmed. Will include the canary gates and test commands in the doc (example: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/api` and feature-flag kill hook).

sam: Confirmed. I'll add a weekly health digest for product and CS with top 5 regressions.

ryan: Good. If we agree on the 4-week grouping for non-urgent enhancements and the 24/72h windows for P0/P1, we can ship this as an official post-launch playbook. Any blockers?

jess: None from PM. Please ensure CS sign-off on the customer comm wording.

maria: I'll get CS sign-off and send initial customer pings once tracker is live.

ryan: Thanks everyone. I'll publish the playbook draft after Fri sync. Drop any edge cases here before then.

cs-bot: Tracker created: https://redwood.internal/trackers/postlaunch-playbook-1720001234 (stub)

ryan: Closing the loop here. :thumbsup:
